corrections.reason: Visual inspection of Col 3 L26 clearly shows ቢከፋኝ ('because I was displeased/aggrieved [thinking the kingdom was disgraced]'), where ቢከ was misread as በአ due to ink wear.
The printed word on Col 3 L37 is ሄደ ('he went taking the one covered in silk, [and the king said] bring it back'), matching ሄደ in L11 and L19 rather than ሂዶ.
